description: Defines the NetworkDelegate class for managing network events and status via INetworkManager interface, including subscription handling, event processing, and notifications.

classes.name: NetworkDelegate
classes.description: Manages network event subscriptions, status retrieval, and notifications for network changes.

classes.name: NetworkNotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles network-related notifications from INetworkManager and dispatches events.

methods.name: HandleSubscription
methods.description: Handles subscribing or unsubscribing to network events.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Checks and handles specific network events, case-insensitive.

methods.name: GetNetworkManagerInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the INetworkManager interface, querying via shell if necessary.

methods.name: GetInternetConnectionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current internet connection status by inspecting available network interfaces.
